one_line: Numbered series card, five clean steps in 14 seconds, the explanation left to a bulleted caption.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 static shot: a hand lays a white sheet on a wooden table, then sets coloured stamps on it. A gold pill "יום 8/10" and "משחקי התפתחות בבית / מאמא מרפאה בעיסוק / חלק 2" on top. No speech.
q1_hook.why: A card in the first frame names the topic and her role (T3, H1), and the series count "8/10" hints at more to come. But it names the series, not what this game gives a child, and the child appears only at 0:05 (H2). No voice or face (H4).

beats.what: A hand lays a white sheet, then places five coloured stamps; series card on top
Top-down: the sheet with two columns of red stamped vehicle pictures
beats.why: The prepared worksheet, readable at a glance.

beats.what: A toddler at a wall with a pencil, the stamped sheet taped to the wall
beats.why: The child enters and the task becomes clear.

beats.what: She draws pencil lines from each picture to its match; an adult hand rests on the wall
beats.why: The activity in action, one idea.

beats.what: She points at a picture, then draws; the sheet is full of lines
beats.why: The finished sheet is the result.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: "אהבתם את הרעיון? שמרו את הסרטון לפעילות הבאה בבית 📌" (save), and "אין לכם חותמות?" with a substitute. No comment or send ask.
q2_flow.why: A new view every 2 to 4 s in a 14 s demo, with the child's action as the payoff, makes it easy to finish and rewatch (R3, R1, R2). The last frame does not lead back to the first, so it is not a loop (R4). What the game trains is left to the caption (K4).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. Caption: "אהבתם את הרעיון? שמרו את הסרטון לפעילות הבאה בבית 📌".
q3_cta.why: A save ask with a reason, reuse the idea, suits a tip format (C2, R7), as one action (C1). But it is only in the caption, with nothing on screen or said at the end (C6). A send to another parent would be the stronger ask for reach (C4).

q4_shown.what: A white sheet and five coloured stamps with vehicle pictures; a sheet stamped in two columns; a toddler about 2 to 3, face partly seen, drawing pencil lines between matching pictures on a sheet taped to a wall. No brand, price or benefit text.
q4_shown.why: The activity runs from setup to a child doing it, so a viewer can copy it (K2, F8), with the stamps handled at 0:01 (S1) and a finished sheet as the result. The parent-therapist role is only in the title card (S6). The toddler's face on screen is what LumeBook's own Reels avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: 6 shots in 14.1 s, 2.4 s average, straight cuts at 3.9, 5.2, 7.9, 8.9 and 11.5 s. Static camera in each shot, moving from table to top-down to wall. The card is on screen 0:00 to 0:02. No voice. Ends on the child pointing.
q5_edit.why: Cuts every 1 to 4 s between different views keep a short Reel lively and each adds a step (E2, R3, E1). Nothing is timed to sound (E4), the card leaves at 0:03 so a muted viewer gets no explanation (T1), and it ends abruptly (E8).

q6_topic.what: A toddler matching game with stamps and a wall-mounted sheet, day 8 of 10 in a home developmental games series. Serves a parent wanting simple home activities.
q6_topic.why: A simple activity from everyday items is useful and saveable (K4, R7), with a modest developmental purpose in the caption (K4). Parents of toddlers look for exactly this kind of idea (K6). No occasion or gift (K7).

q7_filmed.what: A phone on a stand: a table-level medium shot, a top-down shot, then medium and over-the-shoulder shots of a toddler at a wall, in daylight at home. The toddler's face is partly seen.
q7_filmed.why: Fixed shots against plain white make the stamps, the lines and the hand readable (F7, F4), and a home setting looks native (H8). Full 9:16 and sharp (F1, F3). The card sits at about 16 to 39% down, inside the safe zone (T4, F2).

q8_text.on_screen: A gold pill "יום 8/10" and three lines of white bold text, centred at about 16 to 39% down, 0:00 to 0:02: "משחקי התפתחות בבית", "מאמא מרפאה בעיסוק", "חלק 2". Nothing else: no subtitles, labels or CTA.
q8_text.caption: "יום 8/10 של רעיונות למשחקי התפתחות בבית 🎈". About 90 words: the activity, a substitute if there are no stamps, four bullets on what it practises, a save ask, five hashtags and three words without the sign. No disclosure.
q8_text.why: The card states the topic, her role and the series position in big, readable type inside the safe zone (T3, T5, T4), but then no text explains the task, so a muted viewer must infer it (T1). The caption is the real content, with topic keywords and five hashtags (T7).

weak_points: No spoken or on-screen explanation of what the game trains; the card is gone after 0:02; the save ask only in the caption; no brand or source for the stamps; the toddler's face shown; hashtags partly broken.
lumebook_takeaway: Film the setup and the finished page with hands only, add a numbered series card on top and a save prompt on the last frame.
not_verified: The stamp set's brand and where to buy it; the toddler's age (about 2 to 3 by sight); the audio (no speech, not silent at mean -15.8 dB, likely music); whether earlier days exist. Corrections to the first pass: the series card is on screen 0:00 to 0:02, not the whole opening; the toddler's face is clearly visible at 0:05 and 0:09 to 0:10; three of the caption's tags lack the # sign. Plays 49,667, likes 292, comments 15 on 15 Oct are context only. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
